trailhead.label: Piazza Mattei, San Giuseppe, Mompantero, the board’s start

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
A sunny south-facing slope: the board advises against July and August; carry water for your dog.
Village lanes at the start and end and a short stretch on the SP209 at San Giuseppe: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Stony mountain paths (T2) for most of the loop: watch your dog’s footing.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
